title.zh: Strive opens $1B ATM program for SATS preferred stock, may fund Bitcoin purchase
title.en: Strive opens $1B ATM program for SATS preferred stock, may fund Bitcoin purchase

current_state.zh: Strive entered an at-the-market sales agreement with Cantor Fitzgerald, Barclays and five other firms to sell up to $1 billion of its 15%-dividend Series A perpetual preferred stock (SATS), with net proceeds potentially used for Bitcoin purchases, working capital, income-generating investments, and share repurchases.
